description: Alary wears a long burgundy velvet-like noble tunic with fine gold embroidered borders, gold heraldic motifs near the hem and a matching decorated belt with a round metal buckle and hanging strap. A cream linen shirt shows at the split neck and in long sleeves with embroidered cuffs. A dark blue-grey and gold patterned cloak is fastened at his shoulders by two circular clasps and a short chain. Dark fitted trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. His hands are loosely clasped and bear a ring; his head is bare. No armor or weapons are visible.
